svg.title: DNS query failure handling flowchart
svg.desc: Flowchart showing what happens when a DNS query fails: retry, fallback resolver, cache check, then NXDOMAIN or SERVFAIL error

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does a DNS query get sent initially?')
sendPrompt('What causes a DNS query to get no response?')
sendPrompt('What happens after a successful DNS response?')
sendPrompt('How many times does a DNS resolver retry a query?')
sendPrompt('What is a fallback DNS resolver?')
sendPrompt('How does DNS cache help when a query fails?')
sendPrompt('What is stale cache in DNS?')
sendPrompt('What is a NXDOMAIN DNS error?')
sendPrompt('What is a SERVFAIL DNS error?')
